::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 29th [1896]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Hampshire Record Office 67M92W/82/24
:::

Dear [Mr Wooldridge](people/person_2094.qmd)
The house said to be occupied by E Collins is that of [Charles Ray Junior](people/person_2111.qmd)  [Mrs Collins](people/person_360.qmd) has been dead these 30 years.

Hall ought to be Pearson  John Price rents a very small cottage adjoining his shop, I believe one of Barfoot’s sons sleeps there but Price is accountable for it.

[Mrs Bishop](people/person_156.qmd) is really the tenant of the whole house  Ruddock is her lodger  Does this make any difference?

County Police should be substituted for [J Davis](people/person_2148.qmd), as the present constable is Kemp

Day is dead, his house is occupied by Mrs Jewell

Otherwise I think all is correct

Yours truly
C M Yonge
